* Diagnostic characterization
.lib "__MODEL_LIB__" tt
.include "__DUT_NETLIST__"
.option scale=1e-6
.temp -40
VDD vdd 0 1.71
IREF vdd ibias 5e-06
VIN stim 0 DC 0.5 AC 1
LFB out fb 1G
CFB fb 0 1
XDUT stim fb out ibias vdd 0 two_stage_ota
CLOAD out 0 5e-12
.control
set num_threads=1
op
print v(out) i(vdd)
ac dec 60 1 1G
let gain_db=vdb(out)
let phase_deg=180/PI*cph(v(out))
meas ac gain_dc FIND gain_db AT=1
meas ac ugb WHEN gain_db=0 FALL=1
meas ac phase_ugb FIND phase_deg WHEN gain_db=0 FALL=1
quit
.endc

.end
